_comment: Branch rules as code for `main`, applied by factory/bin/apply-branch-protection.sh (repo admin; dry-run by default, --apply writes, a second run is a no-op; re-run after any change here). Only real GitHub REST fields live here: `protection` is the body of PUT repos/{r}/branches/{branch}/protection and each `rulesets` entry is the body of POST/PUT repos/{r}/rulesets (keys starting with `_` are stripped). A rule GitHub cannot express is listed under `unexpressed`, printed on every run, and never silently dropped. Admin bypass OFF for everyone, org owners included.

rulesets.name: main-merge-queue
rulesets._comment: The merge queue is a ruleset rule; the classic protection endpoint has no field for it. One entry built at a time, merge commits. The four parameters the old file did not name are GitHub's UI defaults.

unexpressed.rule: factory/HALT: zero approvals to add, two to remove
unexpressed.why: GitHub has no rule keyed on file deletion. Ruleset `required_reviewers` (file_patterns + minimum_approvals) needs a Team reviewer, so it is unavailable on this user-owned repo, and it would gate adding HALT as much as removing it. Until decided, HALT follows the CODEOWNERS rule: one code-owner approval to add and to remove.
